{{Quote|A caranak is an aquatic fowl native to Endor. It is notoriously difficult to domesticate."<br />"…a wild goose?"<br />"Just so.|[[Jagged Fel]] and Tahiri Veila|<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
'''Wild [[Goose|geese]]''' were [[Bird/Legends|birds]] which made proverbially-elusive prey. The phrase '''wild goose chase''' was a [[List of phrases and slang/Legends|slang phrase]] used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which referred to an ultimately pointless activity which distracted someone from a desired objective.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref> When [[Javis Tyrr]] was sent on a fruitless search at the [[Indigo Tower]], [[Tahiri Veila]] referred to the operation as a "wild goose."<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Wild goose chase,"<ref name="Goosey">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/wild-goose-chase|text=wild goose chase|quote=If you are on a wild goose chase, you waste a lot of time searching for something that you have little chance of finding, because you have been given incorrect information.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220916114931}}</ref> which the ''Star Wars'' expression,<ref name="Star Wars 1977 30" /> and the term "wild goose," are based on,<ref name="Omen" /> is a real-world idiom.<ref name="Goosey" />
